appName.description: Extension name, shown in the store and on chrome://extensions

appDescription.message: Voice input for any text field on the web. Uses the browser's built-in speech recognition.
appDescription.description: Extension description. The store shows it as the summary; 132 characters at most

actionTitle.message: vtype: switch this site on or off

micTriggerLabel.description: Accessible name of the small mic next to a text field

micTriggerHint.message: Press to dictate. Drag to move it out of the way.
micTriggerHint.description: Tooltip on the small mic, which is both a button and draggable

micSiteOff.message: Don't use vtype on this site

panelUnavailable.message: vtype is not available on this page. Reload the page and try again.

panelDidNotStart.message: Voice input did not start. Try again.

panelNotAllowed.message: The microphone is not allowed for vtype.

panelOpenPermission.description: Button on the message that opens the microphone permission page

panelNetwork.message: Could not reach the speech recognition service.

panelSuperseded.message: Stopped: voice input started somewhere else.

panelUnsupported.message: This browser cannot do speech recognition.

panelOtherError.description: {code} is the error code the recognition engine reported

panelKeptFieldGone.message: The text field is gone, so the text was kept here.

panelKeptNotTarget.message: That field cannot take the text, so it was kept here.

panelKeptComposing.message: Text entry was busy (IME), so the text was kept here.

panelKeptSilence.message: Stopped after silence. Press the mic to continue; the text is kept.

panelStoppedSilence.message: Stopped after a silence. Press the mic to go on.

panelNotSubmitted.message: The text is in the field. vtype could not tell how this page is sent, so it sent nothing.

permissionLead.message: vtype turns your speech into text in web text fields. Allow the microphone once here; after that no site will ask again.

permissionPrivacy.message: What you say is sent by the browser's speech recognition to Google's speech recognition service, which turns it into text (this is how speech recognition works in Chrome). Nothing is sent to the developer of vtype.
permissionPrivacy.description: Shown above the grant button on the microphone permission page, before the user decides

permissionRequesting.message: Waiting for your answer in the browser dialog...

permissionGranted.message: Allowed. You can close this tab.

permissionDenied.message: Not allowed. Allow the microphone for this extension in the address bar's site settings, then press the button again.

permissionAfter.message: To use vtype: focus a text field, rest the mouse on the small mic next to it, and press the mic in the panel.

speech_title.description: Desktop app's speech page (opened by the desktop app in its own Chrome): heading

speech_consent_lead.message: What you say is sent to Google by Google Chrome's speech recognition and comes back as text. vtype itself sends it nowhere.
speech_consent_lead.description: Desktop app's speech page: shown before the first recording; the user must agree before anything is recognised

speech_mic_lead.message: Please allow the microphone. In Chrome's prompt, choose to allow it while visiting the site, and you will not be asked again.

speech_mic_denied.message: The microphone was not allowed. Allow it for this page in Chrome, then press the button again.

speech_ready.message: vtype is ready. This window closes by itself.

speech_ready_stay.message: vtype is ready. Leave this window open: closing it means the microphone is asked for again at the next recording.
speech_ready_stay.description: Desktop app's speech page, when it has to stay on screen because the microphone was allowed only this time

speech_disconnected.message: Not connected to vtype. Check that vtype is running.

permissionAlready.message: The microphone is already allowed. You can close this tab.

optionsLead.message: vtype puts what you say into the text field you are working in. Choose how recording starts.

optionsClickHint.message: Press the small mic next to the field to start, and press it again to stop. Resting the mouse on it only opens the panel.

optionsHoverLabel.message: Rest the mouse on the mic

optionsHoverHint.message: Recording starts as soon as the panel opens by itself, so you can speak straight away. You can still press the mic to start and stop.

optionsDisplayAllLabel.message: On every text field on screen (recommended)

optionsDisplayAllHint.message: Each text field you can see gets a faint mic next to it, without you touching anything. On a page with very many fields, only the first ones get one; the rest appear as you move the mouse over them.

optionsDisplayHoverLabel.message: Only on the field I am using

optionsDisplayHoverHint.message: A mic appears on the field the mouse is over, and on the field the caret is in. Moving away takes it back.

optionsFailed.message: Could not save the setting. vtype keeps starting when you press the mic.

optionsSitesLead.message: vtype is on everywhere by default. A site on this list gets no mic at all. You can also switch the site you are on off from the panel itself, and on again with the vtype button in the toolbar.

optionsSitesEmpty.message: vtype is on everywhere: no site has been switched off.

optionsSitesAdded.description: {site} is an origin such as https://example.com, or *.example.com

optionsSitesRemoved.description: {site} is an origin such as https://example.com, or *.example.com

optionsSitesBadInput.message: That is not a site address. Write it like example.com, https://example.com or *.example.com.

optionsPositionsLead.message: You can drag the small mic aside on a site where it covers one of the site's own buttons. vtype remembers that for the site. This puts every site back to where vtype normally puts it.

optionsDiagLead.message: Off unless you switch it on. It exists for one question: why did a recording stop where it did. It records timings, how many times recognition restarted, how many characters arrived and why a recording ended — never what you said.

optionsDiagHint.message: Kept in this browser only, at most 300 entries, oldest dropped first. Switching this off stops the recording; it does not empty what is already there.

optionsDiagCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

optionsReset.message: Put the mic back on every site

optionsResetDoneOne.description: Used when exactly one site was put back; see optionsResetDoneMany for the rest

optionsResetDoneMany.description: {count} is 0 or 2 and above. A language with one plural form uses the same text in both keys

optionsResetNone.message: The mic has not been moved on any site.

optionsResetFailed.message: Could not clear the saved positions.

native_trayTooltip.description: Desktop app: tooltip of the tray / menu bar icon

native_trayToggleRecording.description: Desktop app: tray menu item that starts or stops recording (shown where the tray icon cannot be clicked)

native_trayShowIcon.description: Desktop app: tray menu checkbox that shows the floating mic near the taskbar

native_trayHideOnFullscreen.description: Desktop app: tray menu checkbox that hides the floating mic while a full-screen app is in front

native_trayModeNormal.description: Desktop app: tray menu radio item, input mode that uses the language as recognized

native_trayModeEn.description: Desktop app: tray menu radio item, input mode that recognizes English

native_trayModeKana.description: Desktop app: tray menu radio item, input mode that turns the result into katakana

native_trayOpenSettings.description: Desktop app: tray menu item that opens the extension's settings page in Chrome

native_trayReportBug.description: Desktop app: tray menu item that opens the GitHub issue form

native_trayCopyDiagnostics.description: Desktop app: tray menu item that copies the diagnostic information (no transcripts)

native_trayQuit.description: Desktop app: tray menu item that ends the desktop app

native_notifyHotkeyFailed.message: The shortcut {hotkey} is taken by another app. Choose another one in the settings.
native_notifyHotkeyFailed.description: Desktop app: notification when the global shortcut could not be registered. {hotkey} is the shortcut

native_notifySpeechPageNotConnected.message: Speech recognition could not get ready. If pressing again does not help, check that Google Chrome is installed.
native_notifySpeechPageNotConnected.description: Desktop app: notification when the Chrome that vtype starts for speech recognition did not connect in time

native_notifyChromeMissing.message: Google Chrome was not found. vtype uses Google Chrome's speech recognition. Install Google Chrome, then press again.
native_notifyChromeMissing.description: Desktop app: notification when Google Chrome is not installed

native_bubbleConsent.message: Just this once: please agree and allow the microphone in the Chrome window that opened.
native_bubbleConsent.description: Desktop app: bubble while the first-run window (consent and microphone) is open

native_bubbleConnecting.description: Desktop app: shown above the mic icon while it waits (up to 10 seconds) for the extension in Chrome

native_notifyPasteManually.message: The text is on the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V to paste it.
native_notifyPasteManually.description: Desktop app: notification when the text could only be put on the clipboard

native_notifyPasswordField.message: A password field is in front, so vtype did not type anything.
native_notifyPasswordField.description: Desktop app: notification when recognized text was not typed because a password field is in front

native_notifyAccessibility.message: To type, allow vtype in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
native_notifyAccessibility.description: Desktop app (macOS): notification when vtype may not send keystrokes yet

optionsModeLegend.description: Options page: title of the input mode choice

optionsModeLead.message: It stays as chosen until you change it. The desktop app's tray menu switches the same setting.
optionsModeLead.description: Options page: under the input mode title

optionsModeNormalLabel.description: Options page: input mode that recognizes the browser's language

optionsModeNormalHint.message: Recognizes the browser's language, as before.
optionsModeNormalHint.description: Options page: explanation of the normal input mode

optionsModeEnLabel.description: Options page: input mode that recognizes English

optionsModeEnHint.message: Recognizes English (en-US), whatever the browser's language.
optionsModeEnHint.description: Options page: explanation of the English input mode

optionsModeKanaLabel.description: Options page: input mode that types katakana

optionsModeKanaHint.message: Recognizes Japanese and types the result in full-width katakana.
optionsModeKanaHint.description: Options page: explanation of the katakana input mode

optionsReplTitle.description: Options page: title of the replacement table

optionsReplLead.message: One per line: what was recognized => what to type. Letters match regardless of case. Up to 200. Replaced words are kept as written, also in katakana mode.
optionsReplLead.description: Options page: how to write the replacement table. Keep the => arrow as it is

optionsReplPlaceholder.description: Options page: example shown in the empty replacement table

optionsReplSave.description: Options page: button that saves the replacement table

optionsReplCount.description: Options page: how many replacements are stored. {count} is a number

optionsReplBadLines.message: Not saved (no => or nothing on its left): line {lines}
optionsReplBadLines.description: Options page: replacement lines that could not be read. {lines} is a list of line numbers

optionsReplTruncated.message: Saved the first 200. The rest were not saved.
optionsReplTruncated.description: Options page: status when more than 200 replacements were written

optionsDiagReportNote.message: Pasting this into a bug report makes the cause easier to find. It holds no audio and no transcript.
optionsDiagReportNote.description: Options page: next to 'copy the log', says the log helps a bug report and holds no speech

optionsReportTitle.description: Options page: title of the bug report section

optionsReportLead.message: Opens the report form on GitHub with the version, OS and browser filled in. Nothing is sent until you submit it yourself.
optionsReportLead.description: Options page: explains that the button opens the GitHub form and sends nothing

optionsReportOpen.description: Options page: button that opens the GitHub issue form

optionsDesktopTitle.description: Options page: title of the desktop link section

optionsDesktopLead.message: With the vtype desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux), you can dictate into any app, not only web pages. vtype in Chrome still does the recognition; the desktop app types the result where your cursor is.
optionsDesktopLead.description: Options page: what the desktop link does

optionsDesktopEnable.description: Options page: button that asks for the permission and turns the desktop link on

optionsDesktopDisable.description: Options page: button that turns the desktop link off

optionsDesktopRetry.description: Options page: button that tries to reach the desktop app again

optionsDesktopInstallLink.message: How to install the desktop app
optionsDesktopInstallLink.description: Options page: link to the instructions for installing the desktop app

optionsDesktopOff.description: Options page: desktop link status, off

optionsDesktopConnecting.description: Options page: desktop link status, trying to connect

optionsDesktopConnected.description: Options page: desktop link status, connected. {version} is the desktop app's version

optionsDesktopNotInstalled.message: The desktop app was not found. Install it, run "vtype install", then press "Try again".
optionsDesktopNotInstalled.description: Options page: desktop link status, the desktop app is not installed

optionsDesktopError.message: Could not connect to the desktop app ({code}).
optionsDesktopError.description: Options page: desktop link status, it could not connect. {code} is the reason

optionsDesktopNoPermission.message: The permission was not granted, so the desktop link stays off.
optionsDesktopNoPermission.description: Options page: the permission for the desktop link was not granted

optionsNativeLegend.description: Options page: title of the desktop app's settings

optionsNativeHotkey.description: Options page: label of the desktop app's global shortcut

optionsNativeHotkeyHint.message: For example Ctrl+Alt+Space. Leave empty for the default of your system.
optionsNativeHotkeyHint.description: Options page: how to write the shortcut

optionsNativeIconVisible.message: Show the mic icon near the taskbar
optionsNativeIconVisible.description: Options page: show the desktop app's floating mic

optionsNativeIconFullscreen.description: Options page: hide the floating mic over full-screen apps

optionsNativeInject.description: Options page: label of how the desktop app puts text into apps

optionsNativeInjectAuto.description: Options page: type, and paste if typing does not work

optionsNativeInjectType.description: Options page: always type the text

optionsNativeInjectPaste.message: Always paste it (the clipboard is put back)
optionsNativeInjectPaste.description: Options page: always paste the text (the clipboard is restored afterwards)

optionsNativeBeside.message: Mic beside text fields in other apps (experimental)
optionsNativeBeside.description: Options page: experimental mic beside text fields of other apps

optionsNativeBesideHint.message: Windows and macOS only. It may not appear in every app.
optionsNativeBesideHint.description: Options page: explains the experimental mic beside fields

optionsNativeBesideTrigger.description: Options page: when the experimental mic appears

optionsNativeTriggerFocus.message: when the cursor enters a field
optionsNativeTriggerFocus.description: Options page: the mic appears when the caret enters a field

optionsNativeTriggerHover.message: when the mouse is over a field
optionsNativeTriggerHover.description: Options page: the mic appears when the mouse is over a field

optionsNativeSave.description: Options page: button that sends the desktop app's settings

optionsNativeSent.description: Options page: status after the desktop app's settings were sent

settings_failed.message: Could not reach vtype. Check that it is running, then reopen this page from its tray icon.
settings_failed.description: Desktop app settings page: the settings could not be read or saved
